objective.primaryRule: per lifecycle arm (L0, L1, L2): the actual-profit role of the arm's final selectable set at C24 (its independent and informed shortlists and the controls C4, C4-refined, C85, E, A, B under that lifecycle): the highest development centre net among qualified members (gates Q1-Q6; fresh confirmation decides qualification), ties by the higher selection robust net, the lower centre DD, then the label; the controls are the qualifying-incumbent fallback. The independent primary and every role are kept; at C19/C21/C23 the fold primary is the independent actual-profit role (PROTOCOL.md §9).

risk.denominator: one fixed $100,000 principal budget (not peak account equity)

budget.notes: Distinct candidate proposals (centres), per arm: independent 8,192 base / 16,384 maximum per cutoff x 4 cutoffs; informed <= 4,034 base / <= 7,106 maximum at C24; x 3 arms = <= 110,406 base / <= 217,926 maximum (refinement moves counted apart). Backend evaluations: the brief's hard ceiling of 3,000,000 fresh simulations, enforced by frozen per-job caps summing to 2,965,000 (PROTOCOL.md §7.4; resource guard on extension rounds). Counted separately: screen, rung-1/2/3 and refinement centres and neighbours, qualification, cross-tests, folds, sequential, diagnostics, validation, retries (runs.jsonl) and archive hits.
